        ptr += 1

        found = False

                found = True
                break

        # Find two indices i < j such that p[i] != p[j] and swapping them preserves the fingerprint

        if n >= 3:
            p[0], p[-1] = p[-1], p[0]
            print(' '.join(map(str, p)))

        if n == 2:
            print(' '.join(map(str, [p[1], p[0]])))
